info.name: State Department Consular Affairs Data Country Information Passport Locations API
Get all passport acceptance facility locations

items.docs: Returns a list of all passport acceptance facility locations in the United States, including postal facilities, courts, municipal offices, and libraries. Each record includes address, contact information, geographic coordinates, and operating hours.

info.name: Get passport acceptance facility locations by state

params.name: stateCode
params.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (e.g., MD, CA, TX)

items.docs: Returns passport acceptance facility locations filtered by US state code. Each record includes facility name, address, contact information, geographic coordinates, facility type, and operating hours.

info.name: Get passport acceptance facility locations by ZIP code

items.docs: Returns passport acceptance facility locations near a specified ZIP code.

info.name: Get passport acceptance facility locations by ZIP code and radius

items.docs: Returns passport acceptance facility locations within a specified radius (in miles) of a given ZIP code.

info.name: Get passport acceptance facility locations by geographic coordinates

items.docs: Returns passport acceptance facility locations near specified geographic coordinates (latitude,longitude).
